# The Two Truths <span class="script">二諦</span>

<p class="lens-meta"><code class="lens-code">ERDI</code> · Buddhist — Madhyamaka and Dignāgan logic · <strong>Catalogued — a reading, owns no gate</strong></p>

## The failure it names

a courtroom sentence that asserts more than the graph behind it supports

## What it does

the exported safe statement must be entailed by the grounded extension

## Worked example

The conventional register (世俗諦) is what may be said aloud; the ultimate register (勝義諦) is the fully-bounded graph. Court Mode is the disciplined translation between them, and it may only ever lose strength, never gain it.

## Sources

- Nāgārjuna, Mūlamadhyamakakārikā 24.8–24.10
- <https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/twotruths-india/>
